# RevivoHeal Bangalore

> RevivoHeal is a Bangalore-based wellness centre offering Unani medicine, Hijama (cupping) therapy, acupressure, leech therapy, and traditional massage treatments for natural pain relief and detoxification.

RevivoHeal (a unit of Marhaba Ventures Pvt. Ltd.) operates from Frazer Town, Bangalore. The clinic combines Greek/Arabian Unani medicine with Chinese acupressure and traditional cupping techniques, led by Dr. Arif Ali Shaik.
